Seperti kaki sofa melahap sebungkus kerepek, Takeo tidak dapat berhenti mematahkan jari demi jari. Pada jari keempat, Harry semakin hilang tenaga, tetapi dia masih segar bugar merasai kesakitan.

f6d93809b3d8.en: On the final stretch to Waterfall, the currents pick up. Eori paddles and paddles, all for naught. Tears form as her arms give out against the current; she fights on with every last bit of her will, but she's losing ground.
f6d93809b3d8.t: Pada peringkat terakhir ke Waterfall, arus semakin kuat. Eori mendayung dan mendayung, semuanya sia-sia. Air mata terbentuk ketika lengannya menyerah melawan arus; dia terus melawan dengan setiap sisa tekadnya, tetapi dia semakin hanyut ke belakang.

f727cf25d4e6.en: Eori rushes him in pure rage; Kibe runs up the stairs, and Eori falls forward and bashes her forehead on a step. Kibe keeps climbing without giving a fuck. Eori takes a deep breath as her anger cools, then climbs after him.
f727cf25d4e6.t: Eori menerpanya dengan kemarahan tulen; Kibe berlari naik tangga, dan Eori jatuh ke depan dan menghentak dahinya pada anak tangga. Kibe terus mendaki tanpa peduli langsung. Eori menarik nafas dalam-dalam ketika kemarahannya reda, kemudian mendaki mengikutnya.

f7a825c3a4a1.en: Dalila grabs another piece of jerky and starts walking again, deep in thought. Harry follows her slower pace in silence. I'm sorry, but I can't let Eori find out I'm Harry. I'll try to make it up to you—but how?
f7a825c3a4a1.t: Dalila mengambil seketul lagi dendeng dan mula berjalan semula, tenggelam dalam fikiran. Harry mengikut langkahnya yang lebih perlahan dalam senyap. Maafkan aku, tapi aku tak boleh biar Eori tahu aku Harry. Aku akan cuba tebus—tapi macam mana?

f816ec9643fe.en: Author's to-do: after his soul splits, Harry loses the ability to understand anything in the Vraki language, and has to learn everything again from the beginning.
f816ec9643fe.t: Senarai tugas pengarang: selepas jiwanya terbelah, Harry hilang keupayaan memahami apa-apa dalam bahasa Vraki, dan perlu belajar segalanya semula dari awal.

f991cb0d5baf.en: Severino nods, then looks back at Harry with anguish in his eyes. "Looks like you've been through a lot. I can tell. What's your name?" Harry goes through his memories and decides to fake it. "Desmond." "Desmond, do you have any family?" Harry shakes his head. "I—I don't remember anyone." "You're not the only one. If you stay and work with us, we'll give you a bed in the barn, and food." Harry nods. "Thank you."
f991cb0d5baf.t: Severino mengangguk, kemudian memandang semula Harry dengan derita di matanya. “Nampaknya kau dah lalui banyak benda. Aku boleh nampak. Siapa nama kau?” Harry menyelongkar ingatannya dan memutuskan untuk berpura-pura. “Desmond.” “Desmond, kau ada keluarga?” Harry menggeleng. “Aku—aku tak ingat sesiapa.” “Kau bukan seorang saja. Kalau kau tinggal dan kerja dengan kami, kami bagi kau katil di bangsal, dan makanan.” Harry mengangguk. “Terima kasih.”

f99b4ff9d8e8.en: Ryo and the sisters in a Forway hotel room
f99b4ff9d8e8.t: Ryo dan dua beradik itu di bilik hotel Forway

fa5f748b3415.en: Takeo confirms he has the Bagarisa, but he hasn't found the person people spoke of. He tells everyone to watch one another, and not to trust. Severino cuts in: they have a good grasp of the situation, so everyone should calm down. He explains that the other villages are coming to pick up their family and friends, and that anyone who lost their memories will get a hand, if they work their fair share. Takeo steps in: "Unless you're a filthy bandit." Harry's heart skips as Takeo locks eyes with him.
fa5f748b3415.t: Takeo mengesahkan dia ada Bagarisa itu, tetapi belum menjumpai orang yang disebut-sebut. Dia menyuruh semua orang memerhati satu sama lain, dan jangan percaya. Severino mencelah: mereka sudah faham keadaan dengan baik, jadi semua orang patut bertenang. Dia menerangkan bahawa kampung-kampung lain sedang datang mengambil keluarga dan kawan mereka, dan sesiapa yang hilang ingatan akan dibantu, jika mereka bekerja sepatutnya. Takeo mencelah: “Kecuali kau penyamun kotor.” Jantung Harry terhenti seketika ketika Takeo bertentang mata dengannya.

fb10e7c26c07.en: Eori's punishment begins at the Sanbi docks
fb10e7c26c07.t: Hukuman Eori bermula di dermaga Sanbi

fb5ce58c919a.en: Harry says he's never been there—oh, wait, he doesn't have any memories of being there. "Must be hard." Severino: "Not sure I can call you my friend, since we only met yesterday and all, but let's say you're a strong acquaintance." Harry smiles. "I like the sound of that!"
fb5ce58c919a.t: Harry kata dia tak pernah ke sana—oh, kejap, dia tiada ingatan pernah ke sana. “Mesti susah.” Severino: “Tak pasti aku boleh panggil kau kawan, sebab kita baru jumpa semalam, tapi katakanlah kau kenalan yang rapat.” Harry tersenyum. “Aku suka bunyinya!”

fd45d83d9488.en: Severino finds Takeo sitting calmly on the bed, Harry against the wall in pain, and the two bandits passed out
fd45d83d9488.t: Severino mendapati Takeo duduk tenang di katil, Harry di dinding kesakitan, dan dua penyamun itu pengsan
